periods.time: vol-09 ch-001, Seven Stars Festival day two, C-block second match

name.zh: 黑铁一辉0.8秒击败城之崎白夜

periods.location: Wangan Dome arena and exit corridor
periods.summary: Ikki opens the second-round match against last year's runner-up Byakuya with Ittou Rasetsu and ends the fight before Byakuya can move, setting a tournament speed record but spending his daily trump card before the Sara match.
periods.cause: Byakuya's Tengan-level prediction would catch Ikki by the twenty-third move if Ikki fought normally, so Ikki chooses the impossible opening option.
periods.process: At the start signal, Ikki combines Ittou Rasetsu with the explosive movement learned from Edelweiss and reaches Byakuya instantly. The referee needs Ikki's reminder before confirming Byakuya is unconscious. Commentators and spectators celebrate the 0.8-second record as an overwhelming victory.
periods.outcome: Ikki advances to the third round, but in the corridor he bleeds and acknowledges that the match was only superficially easy. The Ittou Rasetsu backlash tears his muscles and removes his once-per-day trump card before he must fight Sara Bloodlily.
periods.aftermath: Ikki enters the regenerative capsule and then the infirmary. His fear of facing Sara without Ittou Shura becomes a central handicap for the evening match.
periods.significance: Shows Ikki's tactical willingness to spend a trump card and frames Byakuya as strong enough to force that cost despite losing instantly.
